# grouper_group_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of a Grouper group, including those it has through nested groups unless `immediate` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grouper_group_members" "admins" {
  group = data.grouper_group.admins.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) UUID of the group, such as `data.grouper_group.example.id`.

### Optional

- `immediate` (Boolean) Lists only the members added to the group directly. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Set of String) UUIDs of the groups nested in the group, at any depth unless `immediate` is set.
- `subjects` (Map of Set of String) Subject IDs of the group's members, keyed by subject source, such as `{ ldap = ["charlie", "lucy"] }`.
